task.prompt:
Consider the following 6×6 integer matrix A (it is invertible).

A =
[  0   0   2  -1  -1   1 ]
[  1   0   0   1  -1   0 ]
[  1  -1  -2   2   1   0 ]
[ -1  -1  -2   1   2   0 ]
[ -2   2   2  -5   0  -1 ]
[  0   1   2  -1  -1  -1 ]

Let A = Q·R be its QR decomposition (Gram–Schmidt on the columns of A, left to right), where Q is orthogonal and R is upper-triangular with positive diagonal entries. Give the squares of the diagonal entries of R, R11², …, R66², in this order as one comma-separated list of exact numbers (integers or exact fractions a/b where needed).

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.
